notes.title: Steam Trading Cards are now available
notes.content:
Steam Trading Cards have been added to the game. The set features 8 cards, 3 backgrounds, and 5 emoticons. We hope you enjoy them. Thanks to everyone who has supported the game.

Examples:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/tQzbaSz.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cGLsr8A.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/el3fbt3.jpg[/img]
